# corpus-forge CI HuggingFace cache warm list.
#
# Lines beginning with `#` and blank lines are ignored.  Every other
# line MUST be a fully-qualified ``owner/repo`` HF Hub repo id, exactly
# as ``huggingface_hub.snapshot_download`` accepts it.
#
# This file is the single source of truth for the ``hf-...`` cache
# key in ``.github/actions/setup-uv/action.yml``: any add / remove
# here rotates the cache key, and the warm-on-miss step inside that
# action pre-populates the cache on first hit.  Tests then run with
# ``HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`` so cold-cache CI fails loudly instead of
# silently network-downloading and flaking on Hub 429s.
#
# Add a NEW model here ONLY if a test (or fixture) on a hosted runner
# actually loads it over the network.  Mocked / stubbed models do not
# belong in this file.
#
# Current real downloaders on GitHub-hosted runners (2026-06-03):
#
#  * ``tests/integration/conftest.py::_probe_clip_local`` →
#    ``SentenceTransformer("clip-ViT-B-32")`` for the multimodal e2e
#    suite.  Resolves to ``sentence-transformers/clip-ViT-B-32``.
#  * ``tests/integration/conftest.py::_probe_whisper_local`` →
#    ``faster_whisper.WhisperModel("tiny", device="cpu", ...)`` for
#    the audio-transcript pipeline.  Resolves to
#    ``Systran/faster-whisper-tiny`` on the Hub.

sentence-transformers/clip-ViT-B-32
Systran/faster-whisper-tiny
